sources.role: production product screens and product-local components
published component library, semantic tokens, primitives, typography, and effects

resolutionRules: The production Clue file decides which components and states are used in product screens.
The published Clue Design System supplies the reusable component definitions and the complete current variable collections.
Rendered text styles take precedence over stale font-weight metadata on similarly named variables.
Application geometry and motion are included only when current frontend code consumes them.
Runtime consumers reference canonical published token names directly; compatibility aliases are not generated.
